title: Append-symbol machine
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer, choose one of its work tapes, and fix a symbol $b$ in an alphabet $\Gamma$. The resulting machine is the sequential composition of a machine that skips forward on the selected tape, a boundary-writing machine that writes $b$, and a machine that skips back; the first and second stages are joined at their specified exit states, and the composite starts in the first stage's initial state.
caveat: The supplied statement references skip machines and a composition construction whose operational definitions are not included.
